extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: This payment policy outlines the coverage, reimbursement rules, claim submission

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: procedures, and cost-sharing guidelines for Medicare Part D covered vaccines and their

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: associated administration fees. The purpose of this policy is to ensure compliance with

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) regulations and the Inflation Reduction Act

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: (IRA) of 2022, which mandate zero-dollar ($0) member cost-sharing for adult vaccines

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: recommended by the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP).

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health plans.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Devoted Health covers all commercially available, preventive vaccines under Medicare Part D

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: when reasonable and necessary to prevent illness, provided they are not covered under

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ACIP-Recommended Vaccines: Pursuant to Section 11401 of the Inflation Reduction Act of

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: 2022, Devoted Health members pay $0 out-of-pocket (no deductible, copay, or coinsurance)

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: for adult vaccines recommended by the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: Non-ACIP Recommended Vaccines: If a prescriber orders a Part D vaccine that is not

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ACIP-recommended, standard Part D plan formulary cost-sharing (copayment or coinsurance)

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: Deductibles: The Part D deductible does not apply to ACIP-recommended adult Part D

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ● Single-Claim Billing Requirement: When the same provider or entity dispenses and

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: administers the vaccine (e.g., a retail pharmacy or in-office web portal), the vaccine

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ingredient cost, dispensing fee (if applicable), sales tax, and administration fee must

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: be billed together on one claim.

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ● Administration Fee Structures: Devoted Health or its delegated PBM may reimburse

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: single or differential vaccine administration fees based on:

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: 2. Provider type (e.g., pharmacy vs. physician office).

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: Pharmacy Network Definition: In accordance with CMS guidelines, Part D networks are

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: defined as pharmacy networks. Administration in a physician's office or prescriber setting is

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: classified as Out-of-Network (OON) for Part D.

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ● If an out-of-network provider or physician office administers an ACIP-recommended

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: Part D vaccine and charges the member upfront, the member is entitled to

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ● Out-of-network prescribers may assist members by submitting claims on their behalf

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: using standard physician claim forms (CMS-1500 / ASC X12N 837P format) or web

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: portal e-claims to receive direct payment or facilitate member reimbursement.

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: ● Please see MLN908764 Medicare Part D Vaccines dated July 2026 for Part D

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: Preclusion List Restriction: Part D vaccines and administration fees prescribed or provided

extracted_content.title: Member Cost-Sharing Rules
extracted_content.content: by individuals on the CMS Preclusion List are not covered.
